description: Live checks of this version (websites, company-owned profiles, hiring by organisation number) on the same 1,000 companies as examples/smoke-1000-report.json, drawn at random from Builderr's official company list.
how_it_was_run: The agent's source files were downloaded from GitHub at the tested commit, checked by SHA-256, bundled with esbuild-wasm and run in browser tabs (node:crypto/fs/path replaced by browser equivalents): registry research from a data.brreg.no tab, the NAV index from a pam-stilling-feed.nav.no tab, and website verification on each company's own site (a browser page can read only its own site, so the website step was checked site by site rather than for all 1,000). Equivalent command: npx tsx agent/run.ts examples/smoke-1000.txt out
